resolutions.researcher_notes: PNGRB's May-2026 NGPL MIS Report (printed p.2, PHYSICAL PROGRESS REPORT OF NATURAL GAS PIPELINE, operational-pipeline section, Sr. No. 8) lists 'Gujarat Regional Network', entity GAIL, under OPERATIONAL COMMON CARRIER PIPELINE, with a non-zero operating length (585 km) and non-zero monthly gas supplied (3.0 MMSCMD) -- i.e. actively flowing gas, not merely authorised-but-idle. This is the regulator's own register, an origin independent of GAIL/GSPL company reporting. url_verifier FAILs the content-substring check on this large-format PDF (documented false negative for this project); HTTP 200 confirmed by curl, and I downloaded the file directly and confirmed the row verbatim with `pdftotext -layout` (row read: 'Gujarat Regional Network  GAIL  03.12.2010  609  8.3  8.3  3.0  35  585  ...  GJ').

The asset is listed in PNGRB's NATURAL GAS PIPELINE (NGPL) register by definition -- the report title and table itself ('PHYSICAL PROGRESS REPORT OF NATURAL GAS PIPELINE') is the support for Fuel = Gas. Confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout; url_verifier false-negatives on this large PDF (documented issue, HTTP 200 confirmed).

PNGRB authorises this asset as a Section-42/Regulation-17 COMMON-CARRIER natural-gas pipeline (distinct from separately-licensed City Gas Distribution networks operated by other entities in the same state) -- a trunk/transmission grid feeding industrial and CGD off-takers. GAIL's own PNGRB-filed engineering document 'REPORT FOR CAPACITY ASSESSMENT OF THE INTEGRATED/INTERCONNECTED PIPELINE NETWORK' (prepared by GAIL/EIL) separately describes the 'Gujarat Regional Pipeline'/'Gujarat Regional NGPL Network' as a constituent regional transmission system of GAIL's wider integrated network. Two distinct organizational origins (regulator register + company engineering filing) -> high tier. Both PDFs false-negative on url_verifier's substring screen (documented large-PDF issue, HTTP 200 confirmed); values confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout.

PNGRB's 15-Jan-2016 register (Sr. No. 6, 'Gujarat regional network (+RLNG+RIL)', GAIL (India) Limited) shows authorised/design capacity 8.310 MMSCMD -- matches the sheet's Capacity 8.31 to two decimal places. The current May-2026 edition (Sr. No. 8) still shows 8.3 MMSCMD authorised/design a decade later (no drift), confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout on both PDFs. Both figures trace to ONE origin type (PNGRB, at two vintages a decade apart), not two independent organizations, so tier is medium rather than high despite the two-document corroboration -- flagging per the country brief's own convention that PNGRB is already the de facto origin of GEM's India capacity column. url_verifier false-negatives on both large PDFs (documented issue; HTTP 200 confirmed).

PNGRB's 15-Jan-2016 register shows authorised length 608.8 km for this exact entity ('Gujarat regional network (+RLNG+RIL)', GAIL) -- matches the sheet's LengthKnown 608.82 km within the register's printing precision. The current May-2026 edition rounds to 609 km authorised (585 km CURRENT OPERATING length -- ~24 km/4% below authorised; noting for awareness only, not proposing a change, since 'authorised length' is the more stable figure used consistently across this roster). Single origin type (PNGRB, two vintages) for the precise number -> medium tier, consistent with the Capacity unit above. Confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout on both PDFs; url_verifier false-negatives on both (documented large-PDF issue, HTTP 200 confirmed).

Brief's recorded values for this unit are StartCountryOrArea = EndCountryOrArea = India (State/District/Location fields are blank on the sheet). PNGRB's regulator register lists this asset's traversed state as 'GJ' (Gujarat, India), and GAIL's own PNGRB-filed capacity-assessment document discusses this network's sub-components (North Gujarat, Baroda/South Gujarat) entirely within India. Two distinct organizational origins (regulator register + company filing) support Country = India -> high tier. NOT proposing a State/Province fill here -- the brief's recorded primary_value is only 'India'; a Gujarat state-level fill is a separate value-change action for Update, not a ref-support unit, and is already flagged for that workflow in the country's deep-sweep audit shard. Confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout; url_verifier false-negatives on both PDFs (documented large-PDF issue, HTTP 200 confirmed).

PNGRB's May-2026 register lists the authorisation Entity as 'GAIL' for 'Gujarat Regional Network' (Sr. No. 8) -- matches the sheet's Owner1 'GAIL (India) Ltd' 100%. This is the regulator's own attribution, an origin independent of GAIL as owner. GAIL's own capacity-assessment filing also self-identifies this network as part of its integrated system, but that is the owner attesting to itself, so it does not count as a second independent corroboration of OWNERSHIP specifically (it does corroborate existence/identity, covered under Location/PipelineType above) -- hence medium rather than high tier, matching the register-crosswalk's own treatment of this same cell (staged separately on the ProjectID-keyed operators/owners tab, sheet_row 808). Confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout; url_verifier false-negatives on this large PDF (documented issue, HTTP 200 confirmed). Note: this Owner ref is already staged by the PNGRB register-crosswalk pass (batches/india-gas/staging/register-crosswalk/staged_resolutions.json) on the operators/owners tab -- this shard entry corroborates the same finding for the main-tab bookkeeping row in this brief and should not be double-applied.
